sourceFile: 1. BRS-201506 DT Report test JIG Frame Array A improve   date 6.12.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but incorrectly merges distinct reports and changed factors into one review case.
issues: Distinct sheets represent different validations, not one clean changed-factor comparison.
Changed factor mixes new version, material SUS, new line, old/new JIG, settings, and numbers.
Baseline/test conditions are ambiguous and sometimes reused across unrelated rows.
Measurement outcome is invalid; specs and defect columns are misinterpreted.
Some cited 10.9 rows are not included in provided context for verification.
correctionPlan: Split into separate review cases or stages by report title and purpose.
Define one primary changed factor per case, preserving line/date/type/settings as subgroups.
Rebuild outcomes only from matching baseline/test rows within the same result table.
Remove or recalculate the measurement-stat section from actual numeric rows and correct specs.
Keep concise evidence citations to title, purpose, header, compared rows, and decision/result rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist for many comparisons, but grouping citations are insufficient for final evidence.
